messages:
Maya: Evening ops — I'm taking 18:00-02:00 shift. Quick status:
- Incidents: 1) INC-432 embeddings read spike (partial degradation) 2) INC-433 kv-cache evictions causing tail p95s
- Mitigations in flight: bumped dedicated pool workers, routed some traffic to model-x-small, increased prefix cache TTL, rolled back v1.3.2 canary
- Next steps: watch p95 > 250ms, confirm redis replica catchup, escalate to infra if we see re-evictions.

Alex: On INC-432 — looks like partner-batch changed access pattern. I added a temporary client-side rate limit (500rps) and increased read concurrency on embed-prod-1. Logs showed ~20% error spike around 18:12, now trending down.

Sam: INC-433 update — applied `max_kv_entries` tweak and did a rolling restart on kv-worker pool 3. Commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/kv-worker MAX_KV_ENTRIES=150000
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/kv-worker
```
p95 for affected endpoints dropped from ~340ms -> ~180ms after restart. Monitoring closely.

OncallBot: Alert: INC-432 severity decreased to Sev-3 at 18:28. Routing changed to fallback model automatically.

Jules: DeployBot reports canary rollback (v1.3.2 -> v1.3.1) succeeded at 18:20. https://deploys.redwood.ai/abc123

David: Left a short runbook note in #incidents under `kv-eviction-mitigation` with rollback steps and config snippets. If this recurs we'll prepare a postmortem — tagging ops and infra.

Maya: Thanks all. Action items: @Sam keep the restart watch for 60m and report any restarts or errors, @Alex if partner traffic doesn't reduce escalate to partner-eng, I'll update the incident channel and close INC-432 once stable. Planning to hand the late shift to @Jules at 22:00.

Jules: Got it — I'll pick up at 22:00. Ping me after 21:45 if anything pops. :thumbsup:

Maya: One last note — metrics to watch: embed-read p95, kv-worker evictions, redis replica lag. If p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets, trigger escalation.

Alex: Acknowledged.

Sam: Watching dashboards now.

OncallBot: Reminder: next scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC.

David: Added a tiny checklist to the runbook: how to temporarily route traffic to model-x-small and how to increase cache TTL.
thread_text: Evening shift handoff — incidents, mitigations, next steps
